grab3d.annotation: Each keypoint indicates an interior point on the visible portion of a component. Suppressed when its largest connected component falls below 0.18% bbox area or visible thickness is < 4.3 px.
grab3d.mask: External silhouette polygon. Interior holes are not represented in YOLO polygons.
grab3d.limits: Synthetic single assembly with photographic backgrounds, held-out background images and azimuth sectors; not a real-camera test. No defect labels.
